defective_pattern: Writing table captions as 'جدول [شماره جدول]-[شماره فصل]' (e.g. 'جدول ۳۱-۴') instead of 'جدول [شماره فصل]- [شماره جدول]'.
why_defective: Violates Iranian university formatting manuals and causes BiDi visual reversals in OpenXML Word processors.
observed_symptoms: Table number placed before chapter number
corrective_remedy: Enforce 'جدول [فصل]- [شماره]' (e.g. 'جدول ۴- ۳۱') in all captions and narrative citations.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of regex pattern 'جدول \\d+-\\d+' where the first digit block exceeds 5 (implying table number precedes chapter number).
